entries.goal: Keep at least one active human administrator.

entries.goal: Validate and resize bundle core and add-on compositions against opaque CompositionConstraint envelopes (bundle rules, composition constraints, resizing).
entries.whyThisDefault: The platform stores CompositionConstraint envelopes without interpreting them; bundle writes skip constraint validation when no CompositionRulesPort from @openlup/core/bundle is supplied or the constraint is empty.

effect.appliesTo: New bundle composition writes and subscription package edits evaluate the bound CompositionRulesPort from @openlup/core/bundle when validating or resizing constrained compositions.
frozenOn: Saved bundle versions, active product facts, and existing subscription templates retain their stored compositions until edited.

runtime.reason: The callbacks are executable server code implementing CompositionRulesPort from @openlup/core/bundle.

entries.goal: Admit, bind, and verify server offer evidence for checkout intents carrying offerVersion or minimumUnits (offer admission, offer policy, checkout offer review).

absentMeans.description: Checkout intents without offerVersion or minimumUnits proceed unbound; intents carrying either field are refused with offer_version_unsupported.

entries.whyThisDefault: Standard checkouts proceed without an offer policy while explicit offer-bound intents fail closed unless the host binds CheckoutOfferPolicyPort from @openlup/platform/commerce/server.

effect.appliesTo: New checkout quotes and order guards evaluate the bound CheckoutOfferPolicyPort from @openlup/platform/commerce/server during resolve, evidence minting, and optional quote-acceptance verification.
frozenOn: Saved checkout quotes, accepted orders, and persisted quote-context offer evidence retain their recorded offer version and evidence.

runtime.reason: The callback is executable host code implementing CheckoutOfferPolicyPort from @openlup/platform/commerce/server.

entries.goal: Find when checkout recovery and abandoned cart reminders are sent.

absentMeans.description: Unpinned checkout recovery episodes use host call parameters, with SQL defaults for omitted offsets. Unpinned abandoned cart episodes use 1, 24 and 72 hours. An existing pin supplies that episode's timing.
absentMeans.source: host call parameters, with SQL defaults for omitted offsets

entries.whyThisDefault: The last checkout wave fits inside the 24-hour checkout window and the cart waves retain the established delivery timing.

effect.appliesTo: A changed schedule supplies timing for new episodes. Follow-up waves of pinned episodes retain the recorded schedule. Older unpinned episodes use live timing.
frozenOn: Enqueued messages and send receipts retain their recorded identity.

runtime.reason: Runtime editing needs episode lineage and delivery replay evidence.

rules.description: The host checkout recovery policy accepts only firstOffsetSeconds, finalOffsetSeconds, checkoutSeconds, recoverySeconds, activitySeconds and profile. Supply seconds as integers from 1 to 2147483647 and keep firstOffsetSeconds below finalOffsetSeconds, which must be below checkoutSeconds after defaults. A supplied profile starts with a lowercase letter and has up to 48 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

entries.goal: Distinguish separate reasons for manually holding an order.

runtime.reason: Native order controls enforce a fixed six-reason hold vocabulary (payment_not_succeeded, inventory_review, risk_review, address_review, fulfillment_exception, manual_support). Applications can subset or relabel these codes in their own UI, but custom hold reasons are rejected by the schema and database.

entries.goal: Serve several markets from one starter configuration.

entries.goal: Redeem promotion codes in native checkout.

entries.goal: Choose the allowed return reasons.

rules.description: Supply exactly revision and renewalProtectionDays. Revision must be a nonblank string and renewalProtectionDays an integer from 1 through 3660.

entries.goal: Set the minimum base unit count required when editing a classic subscription (minimum base units, subscription edit floor, package minimum).

entries.whyThisDefault: The platform provides no implicit floor for classic subscription edits; stores must explicitly install a positive 32-bit integer row in commerce_settings.
